value.rationale: The maximal normalized two-coherent pairing at equal radius is a canonical fixed-energy operator test and gives quantitative norm lower bounds. Across all fixed polynomial symbols of degree less than the integrability order, the result supplies an exact universal rate, a critical exponential constant, the exact near-optimal angular scale, and a trichotomy including sub-Gaussian weights m in (1/2,1). This is a motivated natural sharp operator invariant, not a recomputation of the published boundedness classification. Neither a full norm formula nor a broad new qualitative classification is asserted.
